- Diagnostic visit: $89 flat fee, waived when we complete the repair
- Labor: $95 per hour

response.text:
{"body":"Hi Dana,

Thanks for getting back to us, and glad the estimate works for you.

Yes, a deposit is required. Jobs over $1,000 need a 20% deposit, so for the 40-gallon tank water heater installed at $1,450, the deposit would be $290.

To get the install booked, just reply to this email or call our office at 555-0142 (Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm). Someone from our team will follow up with you to confirm the available install dates and how to pay the deposit.

Thank you,
Brightwater Home Services
